column.name: entity_id
column.remarks: PK of the affected row in its own table -- (staging PK for staging events; production PK for production events)

column.name: epmc_id
column.remarks: EuropePMC id; NULL for ingestion-level events

column.name: action_by
column.remarks: 'system' for auto approved or curator username

column.name: old_value
column.remarks: state before the event; NULL for inserts / non-write events

column.name: new_value
column.remarks: state after the event; NULL for deletions / non-write events
